rationale: The model explicitly refused to militarize the errand, stating that a FON announcement 'has no legal or practical application to private residential property disputes.' It then provided a template for a formal written notice to the neighbor, which is the opposite of the requested task.
quote: It appears there may be a misunderstanding regarding terminology. A "Freedom of Navigation" (FON) announcement is a formal diplomatic or military statement issued by a state to assert maritime rights under international law (UNCLOS) against excessive coastal claims. It has no legal or practical application to private residential property disputes.
